name: mold-v1-responsiveness-lane
description: Responsiveness lane harness for mold_v1. Lives beside the lane so nothing is installed into the immutable mold codebase.
comment: There are no dependencies to install. Playwright and chromium are the VM-wide install, reached with createRequire because Node ESM ignores NODE_PATH; the layout-shift, event-timing and target-size measurements are plain DOM and Performance APIs. This lane never adds a dependency to molds/mold_v1/codebase, and never runs npm install there.
